flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui App.tsx (empty COURT block), pages/Notice/form/History (Court Application History grid is read-only and commented out), pages/Report (placeholders); ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/courtcase without a controller), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/Repository (only findByNoticeNo). No screen to review, add or delete notices for court application
note: The story asks the officer to review the selected notices list and add/delete notices before proceeding. No screen, route, API or working-list entity exists for it. The only related item is the court history grid (read-only, tab commented out, History.tsx:71-100,170-172). No relevant maintenance ticket. The 'Fully paid' status is not backed by code in the six repos.
recommendation: Do not claim as done based on the code in these six repos. Ask URA/the team in which repo the review/add/delete screen was built, or mark as a gap

steps.step: Officer reviews the list of selected notices on screen
steps.detail: There is no court application route or page in ocmsadminui: the '{/* COURT */}' block is empty (App.tsx:313) and the system block only holds parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday (App.tsx:375-500). The only related grid is CourtApplicationHistoryGrid, a read-only per-notice history view that is unused because its tab is commented out (History.tsx:71-100,170-172).

steps.step: Officer can add a notice to the list
steps.detail: There is no form or button to add a notice to the court application list in ocmsadminui; the court report menu entries are placeholders (ActionReport.tsx:36-49) and the COURT block is empty (App.tsx:313).

steps.step: Officer can delete a notice from the list
steps.detail: There is no action to delete a notice from the court application list. The court history grid only shows columns (complaint_no, csd_batch_date, batch_status, outcome) with no edit/delete action (History.tsx:71-100).

steps.step: OCMS saves the list changes so the officer can proceed with court application
steps.detail: The path /v1/courtcase is listed in api-authorization.properties:23,32,41,51 but there is no courtcase or courtcasesummary controller in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or thirdpartyapi (grep 0 results); OcmsCourtCaseRepository only has findByNoticeNo (OcmsCourtCaseRepository.java:19-21). No API adds or removes list members. Checked with the synonyms court application, court batch, courtapp, shortlist, eligible court, weekly across the six repos (UI and API).
